d: Mercedes-Benz GLC Electric review: for close to a decade, the GLC has been Mercedes's best-selling SUV in India. The new one carries the same name and comes out of the same Chakan plant, but it has no engine. We put the electric GLC through the six things that made the petrol car a hit (size, interior, performance, ride and handling, the prestige of the star, and price) to find out if it can sell like the car it's named after.
